[SWS_DM_01076] Clearing all configured DDIDs
⌈
On reception of ser-
vice ’DynamicallyDefineDataIdentifier’ with subfunction 0x03 clearDynamicallyDefined-
DataIdentifier and no dynamicallyDefinedDataIdentifier in the request, the DM shall
clear all the configured DDIDs.
⌋
